project_title: Mera Mentor - Data Analytics Course Standalone Landing Page (/courses/data-analytics)
design_vision: High-converting, ultra-fast mobile landing page engineered specifically for Instagram in-app browser traffic on cellular networks. Blends deep obsidian and dark graphite canvas with electric brand neon-amber/orange (#FF6B00 and #FF8A00) accents, Instagram-native pill shapes, high APCA contrast ratios, and authentic Hinglish storytelling tailored to non-coder aspirants.
target_audience: Tier 1 & Tier 2 Indian freshers, non-tech graduates (B.Com, B.A, B.Sc, non-CS engineers), and working professionals stuck in ₹15-25k/month jobs aiming to transition to Data Analyst roles (₹4-8 LPA) without prior programming experience.

typography.anti_ai_rule: Strict prohibition on default Inter. Use Plus Jakarta Sans for aggressive modern athletic legibility with tight kerning. Headlines use tracking-tight and leading-tight. Badges & overlines use uppercase JetBrains Mono with tracking-[0.2em].

scale.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.15]
scale.caption: text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium text-slate-400

spacing_scale.touch_target_rule: Strict 48px+ tap target across all mobile interactions

critical_instagram_webview_architecture.detection_code: const isInstagramWebView = () => { if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false; const ua = window.navigator.userAgent || window.navigator.vendor || ''; return /Instagram|FBAN|FBAV/i.test(ua); }

sticky_top_banner.content: 📱 Best experience ke liye tap karein ⋮ (top right) → 'Open in Chrome/Browser'
sticky_top_banner.styling: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#1E1408] border-b border-[#FF6B00]/40 text-[#FED7AA] text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium py-2.5 px-4 text-center shadow-lg backdrop-blur-md

signup_flow_split.instagram_webview_behavior: Prioritize direct frictionless In-App Webinar Form (Name + WhatsApp Number + Current City/Role) without forcing external Google OAuth redirect which drops cookies in Instagram sandbox. Provide high-visibility 'Open in External Browser' secondary action button for users wanting Google Login.
signup_flow_split.regular_browser_behavior: Prominent 'Continue with Google' button as primary instant frictionless entry, alongside the Webinar Registration modal.

speed_optimization_constraints.video_ban: Zero <video> tags, zero iframe embeds (YouTube/Vimeo). 100% forbidden.
speed_optimization_constraints.image_payload: Static lightweight WebP/SVG representations only. Hero illustration under 120KB. Below-fold assets lazily loaded with loading='lazy'.
speed_optimization_constraints.css_only_motion: All counters, shimmer pulses, and accordion transitions run purely on hardware-accelerated CSS (transform/opacity). No heavy Framer Motion or GSAP imported on this route.

interactive_calculator.logic: Target starting analyst salary is ₹42,000/mo (approx ₹5 LPA). Monthly potential gain = Math.max(10000, 42000 - currentSalary). Daily gain = potentialGain / 30. Payoff days = Math.ceil(1299 / dailyGain).

faqs.q: Kya refund milega agar course pasand nahi aaya?
faqs.a: Nahi, hum strict no-refund policy follow karte hain. Isliye pehle syllabus aur demo guidance dekh kar hi decision lein.

faqs.q: Course access kitne time tak milega?
faqs.a: Lifetime access — ek baar enroll karein, jab chaho revise karo, koi expiry nahi hai.

faqs.q: Kya certificate milega course complete karne par?
faqs.a: Haan, Data Analyst Certificate milega jo aap LinkedIn, resume aur job portals par showcase kar sakte hain.

faqs.q: Kya live classes bhi hongi ya sirf recorded videos?
faqs.a: Live webinar sessions included hain jahan aap directly doubts clear kar sakte hain, saath mein lifetime recorded content bhi milta hai.
4+ years ka experienced industry data expert jo real high-scale corporate data projects pe kaam kar chuka hai, na ki sirf theory teacher.

faqs.q: Kya mujhe coding background chahiye is course ke liye?
faqs.a: Bilkul nahi, yeh course non-coders ke liye design kiya gaya hai. Excel se shuru karke SQL, Power BI aur AI tools tak sab step-by-step sikhaya jaayega.

faqs.q: Referral se kitna kama sakte hain?
faqs.a: Har direct referral par ₹440 aur multi-level network se up to 5 levels tak passive earning milti hai. Upar calculator se calculate karein.
Hum job-ready skills, resume hacks aur interview prep dete hain, lekin placement ki direct guarantee nahi de sakte — yeh aapki mehnat aur market performance pe depend karta hai.

referral_tracking.logic: Extract URL query parameter `?ref=XXXX` on initial mount. Store in localStorage key `mera_mentor_referral_code`. Pass automatically in webinar submission and attach to checkout meta/referredById.

google_oauth_fallback.strategy: Show Google OAuth in regular mobile browser / desktop. In Instagram WebView, offer high-clarity warning to open in browser for one-tap Google Login, or use instant Webinar registration form natively.

speed_tactics.bundle_isolation: Keep landing page route clean of heavy charting suites like recharts/d3 on critical path. Calculators use pure JS math with minimal state. Lucide icons imported individually. CSS animations powered by Tailwind.
speed_tactics.font_optimization: Single font family (Plus Jakarta Sans) loaded with standard weights 400, 600, 700.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT implement OTP or SMS verification. In-app Instagram browser traffic gets direct native webinar signup or clear open-in-browser prompt for Google OAuth.
Build as a standalone public route `/courses/data-analytics` in `src/pages/DataAnalyticsLandingPage.js` and link it in the React Router setup.
Preserve fast loading (<1.5s): Zero video tags, zero heavy external packages. Use standard CSS scroll snap for the 20 review cards.
Include local storage referral code tracking (`?ref=XXXX`) and ensure all interactive elements have specified `data-testid` attributes.
Include the interactive Salary ROI Calculator and the 5-Level Referral ROI Calculator with simple vs chain effect toggles.
